description: This file defines an immutable class RpmValue which encapsulates a type-safe RPM value as an integer. It includes a constructor, a getter, a static factory method for creating an instance from a string, and a customized toString method.

classes.name: RpmValue
classes.description: A class representing a type-safe, immutable RPM value with methods to create and retrieve the RPM value.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Creates a RpmValue instance from a string representation of an integer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the RPM value.
